bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, broke the $146.9 April low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖，跌破 4月低点 $146.9

read.en: Marvell fell 16.4% on Nov 5 to $133.55, trading between $132.63 and $152.15 on volume about 2.5 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($166.6), 10-day ($200.9), 30-day ($239.3) and 100-day ($233.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($184.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($231.35), and RSI is 23.
read.zh: Marvell 11月5日下跌 16.4%，收于 $133.55，盘中区间 $132.63–152.15，成交量约为 20 日均量的 2.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$166.6）、10 日（$200.9）、30 日（$239.3）和 100 日均线（$233.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$184.8）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$231.35），RSI 为 23。

read.en: The close broke the $154.8–158 support (Nov 4 low, May 12 low) and the $146.9 Apr 28 low, both now resistance; the $152.15 high stayed under them. Resistance is $146.9–152.2, then $154.8–158 and $162.9–166.6 (Jul 29 low, 5-day). Support is $132.6 (Nov 5 low), then $128.4 (Apr 16 low) and $121.8–123.4 (Jan–Feb 2025 highs). A close above $152.2 would target $155–158; below $128.4, $122–123.
